description:
Digital logic design tool and simulator


- v5.0.0 (2026-09-12)
  - Added Find Action omni-search with fuzzy and acronym matching.
  - Added image component support for custom bitmap images in circuits and subcircuit appearances.
  - Added new components including Real-Time Clock, Floating Point Constant, and multiple TTL devices.
  - Improved dark theme color synchronization across canvas, components, icons, and wires.
  - Improved timing diagram recording/exports and custom circuit appearance editing behavior.
  - Improved memory/hex editor tools, including go-to-address and clearer RAM behavior labels.
  - Improved project editing stability, view persistence, and text-editing undo/redo behavior.
  - Improved command-line behavior and localization, including nonzero exit on invalid options.
  - Fixed Java accessibility runtime launch failures and various HDL/FPGA generation issues.
  - Many other bug fixes and documentation updates.
